headline: Pokemon Red and Green - where it all began
title: Pokemon Red and Green 1996 | How It Began on Game Boy | Classic Games
video_script: Pokemon began on the Game Boy. Pokemon Red and Green were developed by Game Freak, published by Nintendo, and released in Japan on February twenty seventh, nineteen ninety six. Players explored, caught and traded creatures, starting a franchise loved worldwide. Guinness World Records lists more than thirty one million copies sold for the Red, Green and Blue games. Which was your first Pokemon game? Comment below!

description: Pokemon Red and Green launched on Game Boy in Japan on February 27, 1996, developed by Game Freak and published by Nintendo, and the original games sold over 31 million copies.
